key_insight: OracleImitator learns which features to acquire by distilling an explicit oracle that ranks candidates by their effect on prediction error.
engineering_relevance: Instance-specific feature acquisition can reduce measurement costs, delays, or privacy exposure while preserving predictive accuracy.
method: Use training labels and unobserved feature values to construct a closed-form oracle ranking.
Distill the oracle ranking into a deployable acquisition policy through soft-target imitation.
Measure how much oracle ranking information is recoverable from deployment-visible inputs.
evidence_signal: Across multimodal medical diagnosis and AFABench, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing methods across budgets, recovering 90% of attainable accuracy gain at under one-quarter of acquisition cost.
watch_item: The oracle requires labels and unobserved feature values during training; its privileged rankings may not be fully recoverable from deployment-visible inputs.
paper_title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
